# Bad Version-Control Documentation Examples

## 1. Hardcoded Internal Release URL

```markdown
Create the release at `https://github.com/company/internal-service/releases`.
```

## 2. Unsupported Test Claim

```markdown
All tests passed.
```

## 3. File-Only Changelog

```markdown
- Changed `OrderService.java`.
```

## 4. Hidden Migration Risk

```markdown
- Refactored order persistence.
```

## 5. Omitted Breaking API Change

```markdown
### Changed

- Cleaned up order response.
```
